earnings.title: Dear Shareholders,
highlights: Moving to the margins we are generating: in the third quarter we produced just under $500 million of Net income and $800 million of Adjusted EBITDA resulting in a 6% Net income margin and a 10% Adjusted EBITDA margin.
Revenue totaled $8.040 billion, an increase of 42%
Net income margin was 6.0%, an increase from 4.7%
Net income totaled $483 million, an increase of $220 million
GAAP Operating income was $714 million, an increase of $162 million
outlook: Adjusted EBITDA 2 in the higher end of our previously communicated range of $2.7 to $3.0 billion for the full year 2026.
In line with our focus on GAAP metrics, in 2027 we will convert our mid-term goal to selling 3 million retail units annually at a 12.5% Operating margin between 2030 and 2035.
We view this margin target as equivalent, on a GAAP basis, to the 13.5% Adjusted EBITDA margin target we introduced in early 2025.

items.heading: Our business is subject to risks related to the larger automotive ecosystem, including consumer demand, global supply chain challenges, and other macroeconomic issues.

We may require additional capital to pursue our business objectives and respond to business opportunities, challenges, or unforeseen circumstances. If such capital is not available to us, our business, operating results, and financial condition may be harmed.
Our rapid growth may not be indicative of our future growth and, if we continue growing rapidly, we may not be able to manage our growth and profitability effectively.
Our failure to maintain our reputation and to otherwise maintain and enhance our customer service quality and brand could adversely affect our business, sales, and results of operations.
We experience seasonal and other fluctuations in our quarterly and annual operating results, which may not fully reflect the underlying performance of our business.
We participate in a highly competitive industry; pressure from existing and new companies may adversely affect our business and operating results.
